headline: Fulham's first win makes them narrow favourites at Coventry
summary: Fulham won their first Premier League match of the season, 1-0 at home to Hull City. On Saturday they travel to Coventry as narrow favourites at 40.8%, even though Coventry are 17th with 6 points, one place above them. The Athletic reports Arbeloa had no win in his first six league games. Coventry beat Newcastle 4-1 but were out-created, giving up 1.84 expected goals, while Fulham allow only 1.05 a game. That is why the market leans their way, with the handicap nearly level — a quarter of a goal to Coventry.
read: Fulham travel to the CBS Arena as narrow favourites after their first Premier League win of the season, but the table has them 18th and Coventry 17th — this is a bottom-five meeting, not a mismatch.

facts.fact: Fulham won their first Premier League match of the season on Saturday, 1-0 at home to Hull City, allowing just 0.16 xG.
facts.meaning: Arbeloa's side arrive with their cleanest defensive performance of the season and a first three points.

facts.fact: The Athletic reports that Arbeloa failed to win any of his first six Premier League matches at Fulham.
facts.meaning: Saturday is being framed as a must-win: Coventry Live reports he has breathing space, not comfort.

facts.fact: Coventry are 17th with six points from seven games and a goal difference of -8.
facts.meaning: They sit one place above Fulham, so this is a meeting of two of the bottom four rather than a home side in comfort.

facts.fact: Coventry beat Newcastle 4-1 on October 12 while being out-created: 1.47 xG for, 1.84 against.
facts.meaning: Their wins have come against the run of chances — they were out-created in all four league games in this run with xG recorded.

facts.fact: Fulhamish reports that Fulham are seeking their first win over Coventry in over 60 years.
facts.meaning: The most recent meeting, in April 2022, was a 3-1 Coventry win at Craven Cottage.

facts.fact: The handicap fair line is +0.17 in Coventry's favour — the market rates Fulham only about a quarter of a goal better.
facts.meaning: On the handicap this is close to even: a fraction of a goal separates the two sides over 90 minutes.

facts.fact: Over 2.75 goals is priced at 49.1% fair, with the fair total just under three goals at 2.71.
facts.meaning: Goals are a genuine coin-flip here: the market is split between over and under three.

facts.fact: Fulham have had seven days between matches; Coventry played on Monday and have five.
facts.meaning: Lampard's men have the shorter turnaround after Monday's defeat at Tottenham.

sources.fact: Coventry lost 3-1 at Tottenham on October 19, their most recent match before facing Fulham.
Coventry were described as stubborn in the 3-1 defeat at Tottenham, with Carl Rushworth in goal and questions over whether he should have saved Ben Davies' effort.

Coventry manager Frank Lampard said after the Tottenham defeat: "Keep our feet on the ground because performance was good but we can get better. Every game is challenging. Fulham are coming at the weekend."
Lampard also said of the Tottenham loss: "If two quality players stick the ball in the goal and we had our chances then sometimes that is the cruel side of football I guess."
Coventry Live reports that questions hang over two conspicuously absent players as Frank Lampard weighs whether to stick or tweak his team to face Fulham.

Coventry Live reports that Fulham boss Alvaro Arbeloa has earned breathing space ahead of what is described as a 'must-win' clash at Coventry, with the club still feeling the pressure of a poor start.
Fulham got their first win of the season, 1-0 over Hull City at Craven Cottage on October 17.
The Athletic reports that Arbeloa failed to win any of his first six Premier League matches at Fulham.
